review:
A tumble game with a locked multiplier reel on the left. Tumbles in a row push it up to 20x – but it only counts once a BONUS symbol lands to unlock it, and BONUS symbols can carry their own multipliers up to 50x.

Four or more scatters give 10 to 20 free spins with the reel unlocked from the start, and six or more start Super Free Spins, where it never resets. 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
